art-academic-painting.fake: A large coffee stain in the top-right corner.
art-academic-painting.real: The paper is clean — no stain.

art-amazing-painting.fake: The figure in the middle is bare-headed.
art-amazing-painting.real: That figure wears a large black hat.

art-ancient-statue.fake: Two antenna-like points stick up from the top left and right.

art-basic-painting.real: A high hairline leaves much more forehead showing.

art-beautiful-statue.fake: An extra decorative necklace sits low on her neck.
art-beautiful-statue.real: Bare neck and shoulders — no necklace.

art-famous-painting.fake: Eyebrows angle upward and sit high above her eyes.
art-famous-painting.real: Natural eyebrows resting close to the eyes.

art-gallant-statue.fake: An extra book is tucked by the arm on the left.

art-graceful-painting.fake: The woman is enlarged to fill almost the whole canvas, and the white tag in her hair is gone.
art-graceful-painting.real: She fills only about two thirds of the canvas and wears a white tag in her hair.
art-graceful-painting.also: A second forgery exists where she is mirrored to face left instead.

art-jolly-painting.fake: Nothing sprouts from the straw in the bottom right.
art-jolly-painting.real: A stray weed pokes out of the straw in the bottom right.

art-motherly-statue.fake: The wolf's tongue hangs out of its mouth.
art-motherly-statue.real: The wolf's mouth is closed, no tongue.

art-moving-painting.fake: The tall trees along the far-right edge are missing.
art-moving-painting.real: Tall leafy trees fill the far-right edge.

art-mystic-statue.fake: A large earring dangles from her ear.

art-quaint-painting.fake: A heavy stream of liquid pours from the jug into the pot.
art-quaint-painting.real: Barely a trickle comes out of the jug.

art-robust-statue.fake: A wristwatch is worn on his raised arm.

art-rock-head-statue.fake: A smiling mouth at the bottom of the rock.

art-scary-painting.fake: His eyebrows are reversed, angling inward toward the middle of his forehead.
art-scary-painting.also: A second forgery exists where he smiles instead of frowning — both fakes share the same wrong eyebrows.

art-scenic-painting.fake: The second man and the extra animals near the front of the snow scene are missing.
art-scenic-painting.real: More people and animals travelling in the foreground.

art-serene-painting.fake: The animal in her hands is patchy with dark grey shading.
art-serene-painting.real: The animal is an even white.

art-solemn-painting.fake: The man in the doorway at the back is pointing.
art-solemn-painting.real: His arm rests against the wall.

art-tremendous-statue.real: The container is wide open, no lid.

art-valiant-statue.fake: The legs are mirrored — the left leg steps forward.

art-warrior-statue.fake: He leans on an extra shovel planted in front of him.

art-wistful-painting.real: Her earring is a round ball.
art-wistful-painting.also: A second forgery exists where her eyes are closed.
